input: raw 3200x3 one window; axes xyz; time, condition, position, truth and file ID excluded; optionally perturb once before patching
normalization: per-axis population mean and standard deviation on raw fit groups only; floor sigma at 1e-8
encoder: Conv1d 3->32 k7 s2 p3, ReLU, MaxPool4, Conv32->64 k5 s1 p2, ReLU, MaxPool4, Conv64->64 k3 s1 p1, ReLU, global average pool, dropout .2, linear64->1; shared weights; average seven logits then sigmoid
optimizer: AdamW lr=.001, decay=.001, BCEWithLogits at window level; positive weight=training negatives/positives; shuffled clean windows; one fixed seed; CPU float32
epoch_selection: minimum clean inner validation class-balanced BCE; earliest minimum, patience 5, no minimum delta; refit all outer training groups for median of three best epochs
cutoff: saved detector v1 rule: maximize clean inner OOF TP with <=15% FP, tie fewer FP then highest score; final threshold identical for all five conditions
splits: exact four outer and 3 inner from experiments/hi_v1/protocol.json; full-data experimental checkpoint has own three grouped folds
stress: unchanged detector_v1 wave generator for noise/X/Y/Z and outer fit scale; no HOLD
scope: development group CV; no changes after looking at outer scores; full checkpoint for separate CLI use
C1_decision: After C0 inner evaluation only, the provisional B weighting trigger in protocol_C0.json never fired. No weighted model was trained. CNN score correlation with vibration RMS changed sign across internal fits; high/low window RMS differed by about 2-4x. One C1 input-only experiment was frozen before scoring any outer groups.
C1: After training-only axis normalization, divide each 3200x3 window by its own single RMS over all axes (floor 1e-6); then same seven patches, net, loss, optimizer, seed, training schedule. This uses only the current window ending at the decision time. Potential regression: absolute process amplitude may be useful.
primary_pair: J vs C1 fixed; also report A1, C0 and C0 vs C1. Compare all on same fixed stress and clean populations. Candidate adoption requires all five targets, clean TP gain vs J at no greater FP, and stress TP gain under stress budget. A0 is unvalidated previous default.
